# Decisions and assumptions

Open decisions come first. Silence is not approval (AX-G-004).

<a id="dec-001"></a>
## DEC-001 Where the canonical spec lives (answered, blocking)

**Question:** Where does a project's canonical specification live?

**Options:** knowledge/spec/spec.json, inside the knowledge folder; spec/spec.json at the root, as the AxiomSpec playbook layout

**Answer:** knowledge/spec/spec.json, inside the knowledge folder

**Rationale:** A new project has eight factory folders and a cap of nine: a root spec/ would leave the product no folder (demo/check found it). knowledge/ already holds canonical knowledge, and AxiomSpec asks to adapt its layout to the repository's conventions.

Governs: [GOAL-001](overview.md#goal-001)

<a id="dec-002"></a>
## DEC-002 What feeds the code graph (answered, blocking)

**Question:** Which extractors feed the knowledge graph?

**Options:** Python ast and an ECMAScript lexical scan, no model; A pinned third-party graph tool in a virtual environment

**Answer:** Python ast and an ECMAScript lexical scan, no model

**Rationale:** The owner asked for Python 3 and an agent only; declared spec links carry the meaning, extraction only adds structure.

Governs: [REQ-007](requirements.md#req-007)

<a id="dec-003"></a>
## DEC-003 How diagrams are rendered (answered, blocking)

**Question:** How are documentation diagrams rendered?

**Options:** SVG from structured JSON views, standard library only; Mermaid or PlantUML text rendered by a browser or Java

**Answer:** SVG from structured JSON views, standard library only

**Rationale:** No runtime beyond Python, and labels stay data instead of diagram syntax.

Governs: [REQ-011](requirements.md#req-011)
